name: loading-overlay
description: Blocks interaction while an operation runs. `LoadingOverlay` wraps a region: while `isLoading`, its children stay visible under a veil with a spinner and `label` (default "Loading…"; pass a translation as needed; announced via `role="status"`), become `inert` and the region is `aria-busy`. `LoadingScreen` does the same for the whole app as a non-dismissable modal (focus held, page hidden from assistive tech, scroll locked) — for operations that must finish before anything else, like saving a status change. No brand animation: just a spinner.
